newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo Bus shuffles Asia Pacific team.
newsitem.headline: Volvo Bus shuffles Asia Pacific team.

text.p: Volvo Bus Corp said on Wednesday it was strengthening its organisation in East Asia and the Pacific region through a series of management changes.
Finn Adolfsson, as senior vice president in Volvo Bus Corp, will take up the chairmanship of business area Asia Pacific, based in Singapore, and chair Volvo Bus Asia Pacific Ltd.
Paul West will continue as business area director Asia Pacific and managing director of Volvo Bus Asia Pacific Ltd.

Alexander Glennie will take up the position of business area director China from August 1, located in Hong Kong, and act as managing director of Volvo Bus Hong Kong Ltd. From that date Hong Kong will be included in the business area China.
Michael Ball will succeed Glennie as business area director UK and Eire and managing director of Volvo Bus Ltd.
